The mechanical alloying process was conducted in a planetary ball-milling machine (QM-3SP4, Nanjing Chi Shun Technology Development Co., Ltd). The ball-to-powder weight ratio was 20:1 and the milling speed was 400 rpm. High pure argon was filled to prevent powder from being oxidized.

Subsequently, alloyed powder after ball-milling for 30 h was spark plasma sintered in SPS-211H machine (Fuji Kikai Kogyo Co., Ltd., Japan) at 1700 °C, 1800 °C and 1900 °C in argon, with a dwell time of 20 min. A pressure of 50 MPa was applied on alloyed powder during the entire sintering process.
